Clean contrast, elevated feel, effortless finish. The Azure Trim Knit Co-ord Set is built around that minimal styling where the smallest details quietly stand out. Inspired by coastal textures and structured summer fits, it carries a refined yet relaxed vibe that feels intentional without being loud. Crafted from 100% cotton, it feels soft and breathable while maintaining a neat, structured fall. The white base keeps it crisp and fresh, while the blue trim adds just enough contrast to keep things visually sharp. The knit texture adds depth, giving the set a slightly elevated presence without losing comfort. It’s balanced, easy, and the kind of look that feels complete the moment you wear it, no adjustments needed.
